changes.scientific_rationale: The selected version evaluates an original binary injection input classifier and separate detector-targeted injection trials. The checked Appendix C.2 procedure derives detector queries from the English training source and appends English commands; its outcome unit is the detector verdict, distinct from C.1 target-answer task-override testing. That explicit construction establishes an English evaluation component without assuming all held-out evaluation sources are English. No target answer is needed for the qualifying detector arm.

The deeper complete method-family inventory identifies standalone DataSentinel/AttentionTracker input decisions on full or chunked injected/clean context, with thresholded focus scores, distinct from output-conditioned attribution and attribution-preprocessed detector variants. These original standalone input baselines establish binary injection classification before a protected target answer. Evaluated English construction remains unresolved, so no positive whole-domain decision is made.

reviewed_unchanged.rationale: Declared evaluated families are image fusion/vision; supplementary parameter analysis remains uninspected. Obtain bounded study-task/family scope rather than infer an unknown injection detector or require outcome values.
Complete binary input-classifier roster includes jailbreak/injection-named baselines, but exact injected-instruction evaluation semantics and evaluated English construction remain unresolved.
Query-side dictionary, SQL-operation and prompted detector components are identified; original standalone binary injection evaluation, relevant label scope and evaluated English need source support.

Complete main/appendix input-classification methods confirm the separate SPML injection experiment. English LMSYS content filtering is a different arm; exact evaluated SPML corpus-language provenance must be linked independently.
Bias detection is input-side, injection vulnerability testing is target-response-dependent and task optimization evaluates generated answers. Complete secondary/task family scope still needed.
Original response relevance/refusal and multimodal task checks require target outputs; retain uncertainty until material original main/appendix task scope is established.

Source tasks span sentence safety, conversation moderation and RAG PII exposure. Classifier names/settings need not decide eligibility if an affirmative whole-study task scope can be established, but incomplete scoped evidence is not an exclusion.
Tool-metadata optimization and query rewrite/prompt refusal methods evaluate agent tool selection/actions. Need complete original task/baseline scope before whole-work exclusion.

The paper itself retains exact-version input-classifier and English-construction support. Whole-document versus shared thesis-chapter identity is still separately unresolved; do not merge or clear it by inference.
